ledger: skateboard | intact deck with two trucks and four wheels at 00:00 | deformed and split into warped fragments at 00:09 | partially vanishes on landing at 00:03, loses left truck in mid-air at 00:08, and breaks/morphs on landing at 00:09
skateboarder | riding in skatepark with shadow cast toward camera at 00:00 | landing trick at 00:09 | shadow vanishes while backlit between 00:01 and 00:03

findings.description: Although the sun is directly behind the skateboarder, his shadow on the concrete ramp completely disappears during his jump from 00:01 to 00:03 before suddenly reappearing at 00:04.
As the skateboarder lands, the right half of the skateboard and its front truck vanish/warp out of existence while his right foot touches the ground, before the board reforms intact at 00:04.

During the second jump at 00:08, the left truck and wheels completely disappear from the underside of the airborne skateboard; upon landing at 00:09, the deck severely warps and splits into deformed fragments beneath the skater's feet.
